Container.Name: ReelHaven
Container.Overview: Automatic, language-aware video library compression. ReelHaven re-encodes your movies and TV with every available GPU (NVIDIA, Intel, AMD), keeps only the audio and subtitle languages you want based on each title's original language, builds compression profiles by mimicking a file you like, and keeps Plex, Jellyfin, Sonarr and Radarr in sync. Originals are verified and kept in a recycle bin before anything is replaced.[br][br]NVIDIA: add --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters and set NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES. Intel/AMD: set the GPU Device to /dev/dri.
Container.Requires: A GPU is optional but strongly recommended. NVIDIA users need the Nvidia-Driver plugin.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the ReelHaven web interface.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Your media share. Libraries are set up inside ReelHaven as folders under /media.

Config.Name: Transcode
Config.Description: Temporary encode output. A fast disk (cache pool) is recommended.

Config.Name: GPU Device (Intel/AMD)
Config.Description: Set to /dev/dri for Intel QuickSync or AMD. Leave empty otherwise.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: NVIDIA only: 'all' or a GPU UUID. Also add --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters.
